task.title: Duplicate a profile
task.shortdesc: Create a separate saved profile through duplicate preparation without changing the source.

prereq.p: The active source profile is visible in Library. Confirm its name and current state before duplicating it.

context.p: Duplicate preparation suggests a name based on the source and asks for the target schema, starter preset, and CIS baseline. If the schema changes, BPM plans the conversion before it creates the target. It never silently drops source values and never changes the source profile.

image.alt: Duplicate preparation form showing the source profile, suggested name, Firefox schema, starter preset, CIS baseline, and Duplicate action.

step.cmd: Choose Duplicate on the intended source profile.

info.p: Expected result: BPM opens the duplicate preparation form with a suggested name.

step.cmd: Enter a distinct name and select the target schema, starter preset, and CIS baseline.

info.p: Keep the source schema when no conversion is intended. A selected target schema can have different supported policy shapes.

step.cmd: When the schema differs, review the duplicate conversion state.

info.p: A valid plan permits duplication. A blocked or unavailable plan means BPM creates no target and leaves the source unchanged; select another target or resolve the affected configuration before trying again.
Expected result: BPM creates one separate saved profile and opens it in Guided editor.
info.note: Later changes to either profile do not update the other. A source-stale, name-conflict, or conversion-blocked message creates no target.

result.p: The source remains unchanged and the new saved profile has the selected schema, preset, CIS baseline, and conversion result.

postreq.p: Recovery: cancel preparation if the wrong source was selected. If the source changed while the form was open, reopen duplicate preparation from the current source; do not rely on an old conversion result.
